resources.string: Disconnect on home Wi-Fi and connect on other Wi-Fi or mobile data

Clash disconnects on the Wi-Fi networks listed below and connects on other Wi-Fi or mobile data. Android requires precise location while in use to read the Wi-Fi name. After restarting the phone, open Clash once to resume.
Enter a Wi-Fi name, one per line
Enable device location and allow precise location while using Clash to identify home Wi-Fi.
Enable “Route system traffic” in Network settings first.
